desc:
🐺 BIG BAD WOLF 🐺

It's 1989. You're alone in an old farmhouse deep in the woods. Something in overalls is standing in the yard. Watching. Waiting.

Survive 7 nights. Each night, he gets smarter, faster, and harder to keep out.

🔦 Find batteries for your flashlight before it dies
🪵 Board up windows and push furniture against the doors
🤫 Stay quiet. He hunts by sound.
🛏️ Hide under beds, in closets and wardrobes
📞 Answer the phone... or don't
👥 Play solo or with up to 4 friends

If he catches you, you're out for the night. Spectate your friends and hope they make it to dawn.

Will you survive all 7 nights?

⚠️ Intense jumpscares and loud sounds. No blood or gore.

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite for updates!

Shoutout to FoxyAnimations on YouTube for the inspiration!
